generated_mechanics.instructions: Which content architecture best supports arbitrary player class concepts, generated skill sheets, editable content, reproducible turns, and bounded token cost?

criteria.declarative: DeepSeek authors versioned JSON class and skill records; local validation and a generic effect interpreter execute accepted data.
criteria.generated_code: DeepSeek generates and executes JavaScript for each new class and skill during play.
criteria.narrative_only: Keep four fixed classes and use DeepSeek only for cosmetic text.

recommended_features.instructions: Which addition should be prioritized to keep larger hard encounters tactically readable and predictable?

criteria.telegraph_waves: Visible enemy intent, explicit turn budgets, and telegraphed reinforcements that still meet the selected difficulty's total enemy minimum.
criteria.unbounded_spawns: Spawn all requested and generated enemies without board occupancy limits or a turn-length cap.
criteria.hidden_scaling: Modify monster stats during the fight according to player performance without showing the rules.
